title: Merge | AI-native code review assessments
excerpt: Merge is a 30-minute online code review assessment that helps engineering teams hire engineers who can actually review code.
content_html:
Platform

A complete review signal,
from invite to hiring decision.

Merge turns code reviews into an assessment involving real engineering work to produce hiring-ready signals.

Review Loop

See how engineers handle code after the first read.

Custom Assessments

Calibrate every assessment to the role you're hiring for.

Reporting

A scorecard your hiring team can actually discuss.

Every report connects candidate comments to code quality, risk detection, revision judgment, and practical hiring recommendations.

Token Use & Efficiency

See exactly how efficiently candidates work with AI.

Merge is the first assessment platform that shows exactly how efficient a candidate is with token use, estimated cost, and PR revisions.

merge

Assess the engineering work your team actually values.

Merge gives candidates a real review loop and gives your team evidence that is easier to trust than another algorithm quiz.

content_html_zh:
平台

完整的审核信号，从邀请到雇用决定。

Merge 将代码审查转变为涉及实际工程工作的评估，以产生招聘就绪信号。

回顾循环

了解工程师在第一次阅读后如何处理代码。

定制评估

根据您所招聘的职位校准每项评估。

报告

您的招聘团队可以实际讨论的记分卡。

每份报告都将候选人的评论与代码质量、风险检测、修订判断和实际招聘建议联系起来。

代币使用和效率

准确了解候选人如何有效地使用人工智能。

Merge 是第一个准确显示候选人在代币使用、估计成本和 PR 修订方面的效率的评估平台。

merge

评估您的团队真正重视的工程工作。

合并为候选人提供了真正的审查循环，并为您的团队提供了比其他算法测验更容易信任的证据。
